name: Saionji Jun
source:
Jun is the fifth son of the Saionji family, the youngest brother. He is a 2nd year student at Saionji Gakuin Middle School, and possesses a great talent for painting.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%81%8B%E4%BA%BA%E3%81%AF%E5%90%8C%E5%B1%85%E4%BA%BA]Wikipedia[/url].]
